role: Write ONE slide section as JS calls (no prose). Self-contained — no other file needed.
exact_syntax: addContent(`...HTML...`); addQuiz([{q,options:[4],correct:idx,explain}]); addFillBlank([{code,blanks:[{id,answer}],explain}],{note}); addMatching([{term,def}],{note}) — backticks exactly as shown for addContent, real JS literals for the rest.

calls.addContent(html): 1 slide; tags: h1 h2 p.lede div.callout div.grid3>div.card pre>code

code_blocks:
Colored code: 
...
, auto-highlighted, no manual spans. Escape < > & as < > & in the code text.
html_tags: addContent() body must use ONLY: h1 h2 h3 p(.lede) div.callout(.good) div.grid2/grid3>div.card pre>code(.lang-go/js/html/css) table.glossary-table>tr>td.gt-term+td.gt-def div.glossary-strip>div.gs-pill>span.gs-name+span.gs-def div.glossary-columns>div.gc-line>span.gc-term+span.gc-def — never plain unwrapped text.
rules: Greek prose/English code comments; quiz options same length, correct slot varies, distractors plausible (1 slightly longer trap ok), code self-contained+commented, never solve the exercise, no title/init slides
response_format: Full file → as-is. Plain text reply → wrap ALL output in five backticks (````` ... `````) for copy-paste.
